activities.name: Ross BBA Preferred Admit Application Track

rationale.intuition: Ross BBA preferred-admit pathway 难度显著高于 UMich overall: Ross direct-admit ~14% vs UMich overall ~17%, 对 OOS applicant 更严 (~10-12%). Engine 应通过 majorMultiplier (Business at UMich) 反映这一点, 但当前 SchoolProgram seed (verySelective Business band ~70%) 可能 over-estimate Ross 难度. OOS penalty (geoMultiplier) 也应 stack. 强 profile (3.95/1530 + FBLA Nationals + work exp) EA OOS Ross 估计 8-20%. 0.06 下界允许 engine 在 OOS + sub-school penalty 双重作用下偏低; 0.22 上界防止 EA boost over-credit.

sources.name: UMich Ross Admissions Office 2024
sources.evidence: Ross BBA preferred-admit cohort admit rate ~14% (vs UMich overall ~17%); OOS preferred-admit ~10-12% per Ross class profile disclosures

sources.name: University of Michigan Daily - 'Ross Admit Difficulty' Feature 2024
sources.evidence: Ross applicants self-report stronger profiles than LSA pool; ~30% Ross-admit overlap with Ivy waitlist activity

sources.name: Compass Prep UMich Tracker 2024
sources.evidence: OOS preferred-admit Ross EA admit rate clusters 8-15% across 2022-2024; in-state ~18-25%
